# Mía Beauty Boutique

> Salón de belleza dominicano en 264 S Broadway, Lawrence, MA 01843. Sin cita, por orden de llegada. Salón: (978) 206-9014. WhatsApp y línea directa de Marilyn: (978) 601-2901.
> Dominican beauty salon at 264 S Broadway, Lawrence, MA 01843. Walk-ins welcome, first come, first served. Salon: (978) 206-9014. WhatsApp and Marilyn's direct line: (978) 601-2901.

Horario: martes: 9:30 am – 6 pm; miércoles: 9:30 am – 6 pm; jueves: 9:30 am – 6 pm; viernes: 8 am – 6 pm; sábado: 7 am – 4 pm; domingo: 9 am – 1 pm; lunes: Cerrado.
Hours: Tuesday: 9:30 am – 6 pm; Wednesday: 9:30 am – 6 pm; Thursday: 9:30 am – 6 pm; Friday: 8 am – 6 pm; Saturday: 7 am – 4 pm; Sunday: 9 am – 1 pm; Monday: Closed.

## Servicios (español)
- [Inicio](https://irving1211.github.io/mia-preview-ed493d/): Secado dominicano, color, keratina, extensiones, novias y uñas en 264 S Broadway, Lawrence, MA. Sin cita, por orden de llegada. Llama al (978) 206-9014.
- [Secado dominicano](https://irving1211.github.io/mia-preview-ed493d/secado-dominicano/): Secado dominicano (Dominican blowout) en 264 S Broadway, Lawrence, MA. Sin cita, por orden de llegada. Llama al (978) 206-9014.
- [Laciados y Queratina](https://irving1211.github.io/mia-preview-ed493d/keratina/): Laciados, keratina y control de frizz en 264 S Broadway, Lawrence, MA. Te orientamos según tu cabello. Llama al (978) 206-9014.
- [Extensiones de cabello](https://irving1211.github.io/mia-preview-ed493d/extensiones-de-cabello/): Postura y venta de extensiones de cabello en 264 S Broadway, Lawrence, MA. Llama antes para separar tu hora: (978) 206-9014.
- [Colorimetría y Mechas](https://irving1211.github.io/mia-preview-ed493d/color-mechas-balayage/): Balayage, mechas, color completo y corrección de color en 264 S Broadway, Lawrence, MA. Mira cambios reales del salón. (978) 206-9014.
- [Cortes de cabello](https://irving1211.github.io/mia-preview-ed493d/cortes-de-cabello/): Todo tipo de cortes para rizos, ondas, cabello fino o grueso, en 264 S Broadway, Lawrence, MA. Sin cita, por orden de llegada.
- [Novias y Eventos](https://irving1211.github.io/mia-preview-ed493d/novias/): Peinado y maquillaje para novias y eventos con prueba previa, en 264 S Broadway, Lawrence, MA. Llama al (978) 206-9014 para separar tu fecha.
- [Uñas y pedicura](https://irving1211.github.io/mia-preview-ed493d/unas-pedicura/): Polygel, rubber base, resina, acrílico, gel, diseños y pedicura en 264 S Broadway, Lawrence, MA. Cabello y uñas en la misma visita.
- [Pestañas y cejas](https://irving1211.github.io/mia-preview-ed493d/pestanas-cejas/): Pestañas, depilación de cejas con cera y tintados en 264 S Broadway, Lawrence, MA. Completa tu look en la misma visita. Llama al (978) 206-9014.

## Services (English)
- [Home](https://irving1211.github.io/mia-preview-ed493d/en/): Dominican blowouts, color, keratin, extensions, styling, bridal and nails at 264 S Broadway, Lawrence, MA. Walk-ins welcome. Call (978) 206-9014.
- [Dominican Blowout](https://irving1211.github.io/mia-preview-ed493d/en/dominican-blowout/): Dominican blowout (secado dominicano) at 264 S Broadway, Lawrence, MA. Walk-ins welcome, first come, first served. Call (978) 206-9014.
- [Straightening & Keratin](https://irving1211.github.io/mia-preview-ed493d/en/keratin/): Straightening, keratin and frizz control at 264 S Broadway, Lawrence, MA, chosen for your hair. Call (978) 206-9014.
- [Hair Extensions](https://irving1211.github.io/mia-preview-ed493d/en/hair-extensions/): Hair extension installs, plus extensions for sale, at 264 S Broadway, Lawrence, MA. Call ahead to book your time: (978) 206-9014.
- [Color & Highlights](https://irving1211.github.io/mia-preview-ed493d/en/hair-color-balayage/): Balayage, highlights, full color and color correction at 264 S Broadway, Lawrence, MA. See real salon results. (978) 206-9014.
- [Haircuts](https://irving1211.github.io/mia-preview-ed493d/en/haircuts/): All kinds of cuts for curls, waves, fine or thick hair at 264 S Broadway, Lawrence, MA. Walk-ins welcome, first come, first served.
- [Bridal & Events](https://irving1211.github.io/mia-preview-ed493d/en/bridal/): Bridal and event hair and makeup with a trial, at 264 S Broadway, Lawrence, MA. Call (978) 206-9014 to reserve your date.
- [Nails & Pedicure](https://irving1211.github.io/mia-preview-ed493d/en/nail-salon/): Polygel, rubber base, resin, acrylic, gel, nail art and pedicures at 264 S Broadway, Lawrence, MA. Hair and nails in one visit.
- [Lashes & Brows](https://irving1211.github.io/mia-preview-ed493d/en/lashes-brows/): Eyebrow waxing, lashes and tinting at 264 S Broadway, Lawrence, MA. Finish your look in the same visit. Call (978) 206-9014.
